# FLX-3660: the responses block is not a list of families of the keys they carry

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A Simulation declares its response families under extensions['com.agentics.flux/1'].responses, a list of 1 to 256 mappings that each carry id, treatment, experiment, journey, segments and estimate and nothing else. A key a family does not carry is refused rather than ignored, since a declaration nothing reads goes missing without anyone noticing. Fix the family named in the message.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3660
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
